def test_chunking_splits_long_text_into_multiple_chunks() -> None:
    text = "Cloud computing is a model for delivering resources. " * 20
    uploads = {uuid4(): text}
    uploads[uuid4()] = "A short note."
    # Documents are processed oldest first, and ids are handed out in upload order.
    oldest = min(uploads)
    chunks = _service().chunk(oldest, uploads[oldest])
    assert len(chunks) > 1
notes: Expected behaviour below is predicted from the code, not yet observed in CI; check it against the saved log. ordering by generated ids: the test assumes uuid4 values grow in creation order and takes min(ids) as the oldest upload. uuid4 is random, so in ~50% of runs the short note sorts first, yields one chunk, and 'assert 1 > 1' fails.
